retrievalProfile.description: A retro 1980s airbrushed illustration featuring three stylized female portraits in a triptych-like overlap, framed by a vibrant pink border.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central square illustration containing three overlapping female faces with distinct expressions, rendered in a smooth airbrushed style with heavy makeup and headbands, set against a green tiled background and encased in a wide, solid hot-pink border.
coreVisualRelationships: Three overlapping faces forming a central cluster
Vibrant pink outer frame contrasting with green interior background
Smooth airbrushed gradients on skin and hair
Top-aligned display text and bottom-aligned script signature
coreInvariants: Solid hot-pink square border framing the central artwork
Three distinct facial orientations: front-facing, profile, and three-quarter view
Green grid or tiled background texture behind the subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three large-scale female faces occupy the central square, overlapping to create depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central face in profile acts as the focal point connecting the other two.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top display text, down through the faces, to the script signature at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal within the central square; significant negative space provided by the thick pink outer border.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the border with soft, muted value transitions in the airbrushed skin tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif for top; expressive script for bottom
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Thick, rounded, bubble-like letterforms with internal gradients and dark outlines.
Bottom text: Sharp, aggressive, hand-drawn script with varying stroke widths and jagged edges.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is stylized as a tight loop.
The script 'C' and 'N' have elongated, sharp terminals.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between heavy, rounded geometric display type and sharp, organic hand-drawn script.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar heavy rounded geometric structure for top text.
Captures the energetic, jagged script feel for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed illustration of three overlapping female faces with 80s makeup and headbands against a green tiled wall, framed by a thick hot-pink border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bubble-style rounded uppercase text at the top with a pink-to-white gradient and a sharp, white hand-drawn script signature at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the pink border thick and solid?
Are there three distinct faces overlapping?
Is the top text rounded and the bottom text sharp script?
Is the background a green tiled pattern?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the pink border is perfectly square and uniform.
Check that the airbrushing looks soft and blended, not pixelated.
Verify the two typographic styles are distinct and correctly placed.
Confirm the green background has a visible grid or tile texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Airbrush Triptych + [Subject] + [Primary Color] Border + [Secondary Color] Tiled Background + Bubble/Script Typography Pairing
